name: Haunting Inflection Trick
description: Her voice takes on an otherworldly tone (discordant or mellifluous), adding emotional weight: adds 2 dice per mote to a Performance or Presence roll, up to double her pool. She must be using her voice (singing, teaching, oration) to invoke it.

name: Withering Dirge
description: Channels Essence into a mournful song so listeners begin to die as they hear it: each willing or unwilling listener suffers 1L per 2 motes spent (max damage = permanent Essence), soaked only by Stamina/soak Charms and leaving no physical mark. Once per turn, sustainable on later turns. Nonliving beings and the deaf are immune.

name: Morbid Fascination Style
description: Instantly commands fear and respect from an assembled crowd: they may not like her performance or believe her words, but recognize the implicit malice she embodies and dare not heckle or depart before the show ends. A few disturbed souls find her alluring. Only works on non-magical beings.

name: Heart-Sculpting Oration
description: Inflames or hardens the passions of living and dead alike: roll Manipulation + Performance (difficulty 2, or standard if the emotion is innately negative). Targets with Willpower below the successes are overwhelmed and act on the chosen emotion; Willpower below twice the successes may resist (difficulty 1); above twice is unaffected. Can also induce numbing apathy. Lasts one scene.

name: Elegy for the Fallen
description: Channels the prayers of a living congregation to empower the dead in a nighttime memorial. Targeting a single ghost: lead the congregation for one or more hours, rolling dice equal to active participants (max twice Charisma + Performance) each hour; the ghost regains 1 mote per success (half if not present). General worship of death divides the Essence among all ghosts through the mausoleums of Stygia.

name: Lamenting Ghost Technique
description: Opens her mouth and screams a devastating sonic blast: roll Manipulation + Performance to hit one target, base 1L per mote spent (extra successes add normally). Cannot be parried, only dodged, and soaked only by Stamina/natural soak. Range Performance×10 yards. Cannot spend more motes than Stamina + Essence.

name: Morale-Shattering Method
description: Radiates a nimbus of cold dread that saps morale: all enemy troops within Conviction×100 yards feel terror seize their hearts, losing 1 die from all combat pools and suffering +1 difficulty on Valor rolls. Its influence on a battle's outcome is considerable (Storyteller discretion).

name: Hardened Killer Training Style
description: Transforms a crew of peaceful farmers and children into merciless killers: supervise up to Essence×100 soldiers per week; a month or more of training yields elite troops with combat Abilities at 3+ and a specialty or two. The regimen wears away humanity — every two weeks a soldier loses one Compassion and gains a dot of Valor or Conviction, graduating as Compassion 1 with five+ dots in Conviction/Valor.
